coverage.scope: Bacterial and archaeal species, infraspecific taxa, strain deposits and genome identifiers

sources.coverage: Full bacterial and archaeal backbone, original name classes, type-material assertions and merged IDs.
sources.limitation: Species and below become taxon records; higher ranks remain lineage. Names are not proof of strain identity.
sources.name: NCBI Taxonomy

sources.coverage: Current and historical prokaryotic assembly metadata; unresolved taxonomy retained; all supplied columns.
sources.limitation: Only latest assemblies with an explicit registered culture identifier supply direct strain links.
sources.name: NCBI GenBank and RefSeq assemblies

sources.coverage: All RS232 species clusters and bacterial/archaeal genomes, including clusters without an NCBI mapping.
sources.limitation: MAGs and species clusters are not physical strain deposits; GTDB taxonomy remains a separate assertion.
sources.name: GTDB

sources.coverage: All names and available API annotations in the pinned kg-microbe transform, including unmapped names.
sources.limitation: This is the recorded upstream extraction, not a claim to the live authenticated LPSN service.
sources.name: LPSN

sources.coverage: Complete public ID census and current v2 identity, deposit and sequence records.
sources.limitation: One wholly empty census export row has no source ID and is reported separately.
sources.name: BacDive

sources.coverage: Every captured public strain, its own deposits, taxon assertions and sequence records, independent of BacDive overlap.
sources.limitation: SI-ID, SI-DP and DOI versions remain distinct; only explicitly named eligible deposits supply genome links.
sources.name: StrainInfo

sources.coverage: Complete public name census and type-genome endpoint, including uncultivated species names.
sources.limitation: Discovery names are not all validly published; source statuses and genome types are retained independently.
sources.name: SeqCode Registry

sources.coverage: Every public workbook organism, sequencing project and analysis, including supplied IMG identifiers and GenBank accessions.
sources.limitation: This is complete for the pinned GOLD workbook, not for every IMG database or private genome.
sources.name: JGI GOLD and IMG

sources.coverage: Complete 2025-05 source metadata, all statuses, samples, runs, analysis accessions, checksums and supplied download URLs.
sources.limitation: Evidenced strain/genome crosslinks are a subset of the full catalog; shared BioSample is not assembly equivalence.
sources.name: AllTheBacteria

sources.coverage: Complete public bacterial and archaeal genome census with identity, culture, taxonomy, assembly, sample and project metadata.
sources.limitation: Strain links require whole registered culture identifiers; private genomes and non-prokaryotic records are excluded.
sources.name: BV-BRC / PATRIC

sources.coverage: Exchanged GenBank assembly accessions and supplied sample, project, sequence, run and ENA analysis identifiers.
sources.limitation: No claim that every ENA or DDBJ metadata field or unassembled sequence is locally mirrored.
sources.name: ENA and DDBJ / INSDC

sources.coverage: All reported culture-collection accessions in captured BacDive and StrainInfo; pinned CAFI validates join authorities and formats.
sources.limitation: ATCC, DSMZ, JCM, NBRC, CIP, CECT, CCUG, LMG, KCTC and other collections retain their source deposit identities; no claim of independent complete collection crawls.
sources.name: Culture collections and CAFI

sources.coverage: Existing growth-media and phenotypic evidence from the pinned upstream transforms remains in taxon records.
sources.limitation: These evidence sources do not define complete species or strain censuses.
sources.name: MediaDive, Madin et al. and BactoTraits

sources.coverage: Type-strain genome classification resource, linked in the source directory; related LPSN and BacDive assertions are retained.
sources.limitation: The documented API retrieves analysis-job results. No direct complete TYGS genome-table capture is asserted.
sources.name: TYGS

sources.coverage: Global culture-catalog and reference-strain discovery resources, linked in the source directory.
sources.limitation: No independent full WDCM bulk snapshot is committed; overlapping deposits are retained only as asserted by captured sources.
sources.name: WDCM GCM, gcType and reference strains

sources.coverage: Ribosomal sequence taxonomy and type-strain reference resources, linked in the source directory.
sources.limitation: Ribosomal accessions are sequence records, not genome assemblies; no complete SILVA sequence catalog is claimed.
sources.name: SILVA and Living Tree Project

sources.coverage: Specialist isolate and typing catalogs; BacDive-supplied EnteroBase references are preserved in its primary projection.
sources.limitation: No independent full isolate census or MLST-to-genome equivalence is inferred.
sources.name: EnteroBase and PubMLST

interpretation: Catalog inclusion preserves source assertions and does not establish equivalence. Complete refers to each named pinned snapshot, not every organism or database on the Internet.
